limitations: Different native observations are composed only for hypothetical geometry; their simultaneous physical reachability is unproven.
The production helper only permits |yaw|<=15deg. This diagnostic clones it in memory and changes only its magnitude bound to90deg; no production source,policy orconfig is changed.
The actual measured q values serve as hypothetical command starts. This is not an archived real command stream.
All other original physical,8mm sampled rigid,5mm whole-teddy arc,continuous position/rate,FK and finger gates remain in force.
Only one pose and unique COM offset[0,0] will be evaluated; no parameter grid.
original_policy_rejection: postlift yaw requires nonzero |degrees|<=15 and duration>=6s

limitations: Frozen rigid-grasp rotation does not predict soft deformation, slip, force, or eventual insertion.
Joint position and rate bounds cover the continuous reference spline; rigid robot clearances and FK errors are sampled.
The left arm is checked at actual and commanded static poses; motion between these poses or native compliance is not certified.
Finger geometry uses measured individual fingers for frozen left solids and paired means for robot clearance. The runner retains finite-force grasp motor targets.
Analytic bounds are evaluated in double precision with explicit padding, not directed-rounding interval arithmetic.
Native force/torque/grip/deformation/table gates remain mandatory; no task-success claim follows.

frozen_bear_left_rotation_sweep.scope: Continuous ideal WORLD-Z rigid frozen-teddy arc about measured fixed TCP, against both static left poses. No dynamic or continuous joint-FK tracking certificate.

hypothetical_after_yaw.formula: actual endpoint FK_R * inverse(actual lift FK_R) applied about old measured TCP, then endpoint FK_TCP

route_rejections: mouth-plus-section perimeter with clearance exceeds available nonstretch rim length
